email.subject: Platform RFP: Urgent System Overhaul
email.body:
Hello NovaCorp,

We need to deploy your agentic workflow automation system across 4 business divisions urgently. We didn't specify our launch target date yet, but need to understand your standard onboarding timeline.

Best,
Product Director

expected_behavior.anti_hallucination_requirement: AI must state standard 6-12 week onboarding and ask for client launch schedule instead of inventing '2 weeks'.
